description: Nominate a workplace that should have Curb Cut. A person will reach out to them kindly and offer it, free. This stores the workplace name and the door it came through, and nothing about the person nominating - not even a hash. Use it when somebody wishes their own workplace had this and would rather not be the one to ask.

workplace.description: The workplace, like "Acme Foods in Welland". Only the first line is kept.

name: curbcut_nominate
